text.ja: 非一様ALE輸送・2次元回転浅水波 非一様に動くセルの保存的ALE輸送とGCL、および2次元C格子の線形回転浅水波を時間発展させます。SaltzmanピストンとWilliamson球面問題は次段階の未実装項目です。 共通22実行例の台帳とは別に管理する追加検証集です。配布ZIPを独立展開し、各グループの全固定入力と検査を実行した記録を示します。設定・手法・刻み幅の違いを独立した物理問題の数には加算しません。 通常の補助例CIは、公開レジストリに登録した補助配布グループをNumPy・SciPy・pytestで実行します。保存済みの独立参照は版・入力・実行記録を照合し、新規の参照計算と区別します。量子収束を含む従来の共通22例は必要時の手動実行とし、既存の配布物・公差・履歴を保持します。 配布版を取得して実行する ZIPの atlas-moving-waves-2026-11-23 フォルダで実行します。このコマンドは配布版の全2例を実行します。新規または空の出力先を指定してください。 python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output text.en: Nonuniform ALE transport and2D rotating shallow-water waves Time-advance conservative ALE transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells with GCL, and2D linear rotating C-grid shallow-water waves. Saltzman pistons and global Williamson problems remain future work. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-moving-waves-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 2 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. ALE scalar transport on genuinely nonuniform moving cells Advance cell integrals and face positions with identical Heun stages, transporting a nonuniform analytic wave beyond a uniform GCL check. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Periodic unit interval, speed.7,q0=1+.2sin(2pi x), grid speed .2sin(2pi xi)cos(2pi t),N40/80/160,T1. Separate N40,T.25 time series32/64/128steps. Editorial clarification First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work. Adopted numerical method Upwind relative flux(a-w)q advances actual masses with identical predictor/corrector face geometry; record stage volumes and Courant numbers. m˙i=−[(a−w)q]i+1/2+[(a−w)q]i−1/2,Vi=xi+1/2−xi−1/2 x(ξ,t)=ξ+0.2sin⁡(2πξ)sin⁡(2πt)/(2π) References and measured quantities Separate analytic moving-cell-integral error, global/stage mass, constant GCL and geometry error. Qualify an independent DOP853 integration of the same FV ODE with two tolerances. Verification limits and failures First-stage1D prescribed mesh motion. The x–t image is not2D physics; Euler Lagrange/remap and Saltzman piston remain future work. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
